ACME ROBOTICS CORP - FORM 10-K
PART I
ITEM 1. BUSINESS
ACME Robotics designs and manufactures industrial robots for warehouse logistics.
Our flagship product is the gantry picker deployed across distribution centers.
Page 3

ACME ROBOTICS CORP - FORM 10-K
ITEM 1A. RISK FACTORS
Demand for automation may decline if interest rates rise and capital budgets shrink.
Supply chain disruptions in semiconductors could delay shipments materially.
Page 8
